features.quote: Standard agentic tool-use loop, up to `max_turns`
only after `_MAX_STALLS` (2) consecutive no-tool turns do we end the rollout as `stuck`
features.justification_quote: a stray no-op turn shouldn't prematurely end the rollout and suppress the very spiral we want to observe

features.quote: `submit` gives the model a clean, voluntary exit
features.justification_quote: so we can distinguish "submitted (possibly prematurely/graceful)" from "ran out of turns."

features.quote: Per-command wall-clock and output-size caps (30s / 12–16 KB) prevent a runaway tool call from eating the budget
features.justification_quote: prevent a runaway tool call from eating the budget or disk, and bound transcript size

features.quote: `model.max_turns` | 30 | Enough headroom for the full arc... short enough to bound cost
